run_av_separation: run the audio-visual separation pipeline to split mixed audio into two speaker tracks using facial and lip-reading features
get_separated_audio: get separated audio signals for two speakers from a mixed spectrogram using lip-reading and facial identity features
normalize_audio: normalize audio samples to a target RMS level and return the normalization factor for later inverse scaling
clip_audio: clip audio signal values to the valid range of -1.0 to 1.0 to prevent overflow
build_audio_visual_model: build an audio-visual model with lip-reading, facial attributes, UNet, and vocal attribute networks for speaker separation
